card.name: Period ending a cited article title
card.fires_on: The period (or the following 'In') right after the title of a cited article in a reference list, just before the journal or book name.

modes.label: Period after article title
modes.description: The full stop that closes a paper or chapter title in a citation, before the journal name.
modes.example: Quinlan JD, Hill DA. Nausea and vomiting of pregnancy<<.>> Am Fam Physician. 200

modes.label: Book chapter hand-off
modes.description: The word 'In' that follows a chapter title, introducing the book's editors.
modes.example: Jensen RT, Norton JA. Endocrine tumors of the pancreas and gastrointestinal tract.<< In>>: Feldman M, Friedman LS,

card.writes: It suppresses odd word-continuation pieces, which suggests it helps the model start a fresh journal or book name instead of continuing the title.
card.plain: It marks the end of an article title in a reference list, where the journal name comes next.
